description: This Java class represents an immutable implementation of an ACL (Access Control List) entry, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and permission checks. It is marked as deprecated, indicating it belongs to an older API version.

classes.name: ImmutableAclEntry
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the AclEntry interface, representing an ACL entry with associated authorization subject and permissions, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization and validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ACL entry from an authorization subject and permissions, with overloads for different input forms.

methods.name: of (with JSON key and value)
methods.description: Creates an ACL entry by parsing a JSON key and value into authorization subject and permissions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ACL entry from a JSON object, extracting the first authorization subject and permissions pair.
